about: The round 4 verifier's 20 new phrasings for m11/completeness F1, written, labelled and committed before any run of the engine at f5a33d29. Same shape as take-away-labels.json: each clause, cut the way DescribedSteps.Cut cuts (a full stop, semicolon, colon, new line, comma, and, and then, after that, then, but, while, whilst, finally, next), is labelled with the op it must draft ({op}) or with noAdd: any step or a placeholder, but never a template that adds (create_*, or a step named Add). Seven take-aways, five adds, four changes and four mixes, most of them said politely or indirectly, the way a person types a request. Names are fictional.
